pkgmetadata.longdescription: Wazuh is a free, open source and enterprise-ready security monitoring solution for threat detection, integrity monitoring, incident response and compliance.

use.flag:
Install the multi-node (HA) Docker Compose stack instead of single-node.
Single node (default):
- 6-8 GB RAM minimum - For Lab / small orgs / PoC use - low availability - Easy to setup - Single indexer data lost risk - Overloaded manager possible
Multi node:
- 16 GB RAM recommended - For production use, large orgs - More resilient and high availability - Medium or high setup difficulty - Multiple indexer redundunancy - Can distribute the load to workers to prevent single node overload.
